title: feat(spec,metadata-protocol)!: rename the type registry's allowOrgOverride to allowEnvironmentOverlay, on the registry and on GET /meta/types
body:
Part of #22340
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

> **Correction:** an earlier line here said this PR was held out of the merge queue on #22949. It was never ejected: it merged through the queue at 2026-10-12T06:14Z as `e23eccb164` (landing record on #22340).

ADR-0131 C5's spec half (stage S2): the metadata type registry's `allowOrgOverride` is renamed to `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, on `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` and on the `GET /meta/types` wire field, under ruling C on #22007 (`6028809298`), ruling `6073921182` (Q1 A, Q2 A) and the pre-build contract review `6109457426`, which fixed the name. #22340 stays open for S3, the governed text.

**The console pin moves with the rename, in this PR.** `.objectui-sha` is objectui `e5311165a8d6`, the merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#12168, which carries objectstack-ai/objectui#12141: from that commit on, objectui's metadata admin reads the wire field under its new name only, with no dual read. The two halves land together. Any other pin bump past `e5311165a8` before this PR lands would show the five overlay-enabled types read-only in Studio. The landing record is the contract review on this post-pin head.

## What changes

- **The key.** `MetadataTypeRegistryEntry.allowEnvironmentOverlay` (default `false`) with the contract review's describe and TSDoc. `allowOrgOverride` is a `retiredKey()` tombstone on `MetadataTypeRegistryEntryBaseSchema` whose prescription names the new key: the old key fails `tsc` and fails the parse (`invalid_type` at `allowOrgOverride`). The prescription reads "was renamed to `allowEnvironmentOverlay` (ADR-0131 D6)" and names no version: the changeset ships this as `major` on the `18.0.0-next` line, and the TSDoc's "in 18" names the protocol major. All 28 built-in rows spell the new key; every value is unchanged (the true set is `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation`, `email_template`).
- **The ledger (ADR-0087).** Retired-keys entry `18.kernel__MetadataTypeRegistryEntry__allowOrgOverride`; D3 semantic entry `metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-renamed`, covering the registry key AND the wire field; its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 94). No D2 conversion, as ruled: no manifest, stack or stored row can carry a registry entry. No `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` or upgrade guide is committed (git-ignored, generated).
- **The wire, one spelling.** `getMetaTypes` writes the `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` elevation onto `allowEnvironmentOverlay` on BOTH arms: the registry arm (the `...base` spread already carries the new key, and the elevated value overwrites it) and the synthesised arm of a runtime type with no registry row. No entry carries `allowOrgOverride`. The field's describe says the elevation opens only items no managed package ships; `overrideSource` keeps `registry` / `env` and its describe names the new field.
- **The read-side trap, hand-renamed.** A truthiness reader of the old key compiles against the tombstone and reads `undefined`, which closes all five types. The readers moved by hand: `protocol.ts` `getMetaTypes` (both arms) and `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`, and `sys-metadata-repository.ts`'s `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`. Every test reader moved with them.
- **`supportsOverlay` keeps its name and both keys stay** (contract review item 2: ADR-0049 retires neither). Its TSDoc and its three describes (registry, `GetMetaTypesResponse`, `MetadataTypeInfoResponse`) and the stale read claims in `protocol.ts` and `sys-metadata-repository.ts` now say what it gates: the delete carve-out, no save and no read. **Wording used: PR #22833's**, which landed (`8c105e3d67`) before this branch merged `main`: the removal "removes no managed definition, and changes what is served for `permission` alone".
- **Prose that tied the flag to organization scope** is rewritten, not mechanically renamed: the key's TSDoc and describe, `email-template.zod.ts`, `kernel/index.ts`, the `customizationPolicies` prescription (and its pin), the unreleased D3 `metadata-customization-protocol-retired` and its fragment, and the comments in `protocol.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, runtime `packages.ts` / `mcp.ts` and `sys-flow-credential.object.ts`. A comment that records history keeps the name of its time: `sys-metadata-repository.ts` still says commit `ee58392e1` rolled `allowOrgOverride` back.
- **The refusal sentences** that named the flag name the new key; codes and statuses are unchanged.
- **Tests.** The 74 files that named the key move to the new key. The 20 files that pin the RETIRED per-organization path label their specimens as the five overlay-enabled types (the set those doors once scoped to an organization), so no label reads as "org-overridable = `allowEnvironmentOverlay`"; their `ORG_OVERRIDABLE` identifiers are now `PRE_D6_ORG_SCOPED`. The two plugin-security doubles throw the sentence the producer emits today.
- **Docs and tooling.** `metadata-lifecycle.mdx`'s whitelist table header moves with `check-overlay-whitelist-table.mjs`'s `COL_FLAG` and its self-test fixtures, in one change; 10 more `content/docs` pages; 8 platform-checklist files, both `metadata-plugin.zod.ts#allowOrgOverride` anchors re-pointed to `#allowEnvironmentOverlay` (revision-history `change` entries keep the old name); 3 liveness notes; 2 ADR anchors; the regenerated references.
- **The changeset** (`major` on the v18 pre-mode line, the `22572` precedent): BREAKING, the FROM / TO table for registry entries and `/meta/types` entries, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and the ADR-0087 `registered` marker.

## The console pin (round 2)

**The hop.** objectui `4997995022f8..e5311165a8d6` (`.objectui-sha` was `4997995022f8` on `main` at the merge): 24 commits, all non-merge squashes, over 287 paths (214 modified, 69 added, 4 deleted, none renamed), +13412 / −2428. objectui `4baa8a67c4` (objectui#12170: `slotsForType` stops reading the retired `flow-template` ledger role) is INSIDE it, two commits below the new tip: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 4baa8a67c4 e5311165a8` exits 0, and `--is-ancestor 4baa8a67c4 4997995022f8` exits 1, read in a full (non-shallow) clone whose control leg (`d32869883b`, 50 commits below the old pin) answers 0. Its changeset is release-nothing, so the console changeset counts it among the 2 release-nothing changesets rather than listing it.

**The Console Pin Gate's steps, run locally on this head:** `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...` exit 0; `scripts/build-console.sh` exit 0 at `e5311165a8d6` (objectui cloned from the pin into `.cache/`, 8872 modules; bundle canary `import/jobs` present; one zod version literal; "Console bundle carries THIS tree's @objectstack/spec, and only it"); the dist and its `.objectui-sha` stamp in place; `pnpm check:console-sha` exit 0 (objectui@e5311165a8d6); `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` exit 0. The injection's stale detector is the published spec's describe of the retired key, "Allow per-org overlay writes via runtime metadata API", and it is absent from the bundle.

**Against this PR's wire.** The built bundle's app code reads `allowEnvironmentOverlay` 15 times (`metadata-admin`, `packagedActions` and the shell; for example the read-only verdict is `!u.allowEnvironmentOverlay && !u.allowRuntimeCreate`). `allowOrgOverride` occurs only inside this tree's spec, in the tombstone and its prescription text (4 occurrences, all in the `vendor-objectstack` chunk); no app code reads it. Then the two together, on a booted backend: `pnpm dev -- --fresh -p 38977` on this head (showcase, the console dist above, `check:console-sha` green at boot). The live `GET /api/v1/meta/types` answered 34 entries: all 34 carry `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, none carries `allowOrgOverride`, and `true` is exactly `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation` and `email_template`, each with `overrideSource: registry`. In a headless Chromium signed in as the seeded admin, the console's Setup metadata pages read that wire: a packaged `view` (`showcase_task.in_progress`) and a packaged `dashboard` (`showcase_chart_gallery`) open with the `writable` badge and an editable designer, while a packaged `flow` (`showcase_task_completed`) and a packaged `object` (`showcase_account`) open `create-only` and "locked". No page names `allowOrgOverride`. The server was stopped afterwards. In process, the `getMetaTypes` pin (`protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`) and S1's five-type file on both topologies are green on this head.

**The artefacts that travel with the pin**, in the shape PR #22794 used:
- `.changeset/console-e5311165a8d6.md`, derived by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` from the changesets objectui declared over the range (21 releasing, 4 breaking by their authors' annotation, no declared `major`). Its ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, and it answers each declared-breaking objectui change: objectui#12141 is this PR's own rename, whose prescription and `registered` disposition live in `22340-registry-allow-environment-overlay.md`; the three objectui#12130 changes move objectui's own form-field face, no ObjectStack key.
- `sdui.manifest.json` and `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, regenerated from the built tree at the pin: 107 components; one input description changed (the record activity feed's `showCompleted`, objectui#12106), and no component, input, type or required flag moved.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, re-recorded at the pin: the 214-line grammar region, the 25 diagnostic codes and the containment predicate are unchanged.
- `.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-e5311165a8d6.md` (`@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`) and the re-measured citations. All 55 asserting citations (49 hand-written, 6 in the generated migrations registry) were mapped through the hop. Five cited files changed (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, `data-table.tsx`, `form.tsx`, `record-related-list.tsx`, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts`) and every cited line in them moved or held byte-identical; each record gains a hop sentence, and the anchors that moved are re-pointed where the records cite them at this pin. The six migration entries' corpus counts were re-taken with `git grep -o -F` (8506 tracked files; 124 zero tokens still zero; `Span` 517 to 519, both new hits `colSpan`). `check:objectui-pin-citations --verify-anchors` against objectui at the pin: 55 asserting citations match, 13 anchor content assertions verified.

## New pins

- `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-retirement.test.ts`: the parse refuses the old key with the rename (code, path, prescription text; `false` refused like `true`); the new key parses and defaults to `false` with no old key grown back; every built-in row states the new key, none the old, and the true set is exactly the five; the retired-keys registration.
- `kernel/metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-absence.test.ts` (`repo` project, radius already declared for `@objectstack/spec#test:repo`): a tree-scoped, AST-read absence of any CODE reference to `allowOrgOverride` in `packages/**/*.ts` and `examples/*/src/**/*.ts`. Comments and strings are history and are not judged; the tombstone declaration is exempt by shape. The sibling refusal pin is counted apart and REQUIRED to be found, so the walk carries a live positive control.
- `objectql/protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`: both writer arms carry `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, the hatch elevation lands on it on both arms, and `not.toHaveProperty('allowOrgOverride')` on every entry.
- S1's `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` under the new name on both topologies, plus the wire absence; the identity pins (`org-scoped-write-refused`, `adr0005-org-override-rollback`, `overlay-precedence`) read the new key.

## Ablation (round 1; committed fix first; restored blob-equal)

Dropped the hand rename of `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`'s reader (`if (!entry.allowEnvironmentOverlay) continue;` back to the old key) through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor 1 → 0, mutant 0 → 1 on disk; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. S1's five-type file: **20 failed / 6 passed of 26** (the 6 are the wire and identity cases, which do not read that set). Restored: blob `eff1a12c83e2` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; preflight `--absent` clean over 24 built files; the same file **26 / 26 passed**.

## Readings (head `49ef13a518`)

- **Residual `allowOrgOverride` in non-test source:** the tombstone, its prescription and TSDoc, the registry's naming note, the retired-keys and D3 entries, the rationale fragment, two shipped protocol-17 D3 entries, `18.metadata-write-organization-scope-refused` (history), the generated `authorable-surface/kernel.json` `[RETIRED]` row and the untouched `authorable-surface.base.json`, four history comments (`protocol.ts` retired exemption, a quoted docs sentence and the commit `ee58392e1` record in `sys-metadata-repository.ts`, `rest-server.ts`), two ADR-anchor history notes, and the checker's header note. No code reference (the absence pin).
- **Surfaces (spec-property-retirement).** Apply: schema, retired-keys + D3 + fragment, generated baselines (`authorable-surface/kernel.json`, `authorable-defaults/kernel.json`, four reference pages), pin tests (radius declared), examples (one comment), docs, changeset, the `check:generated` source audits and the dogfood radius. Do not apply: orphan value schema (boolean), D2 conversion (ruled out), liveness ledger row (none exists for the registry entry; the three prose notes follow the name), forms and i18n (no `*.form.ts` input), CLI advisory lint (ledger-driven, no row), published skills (S3). `api-surface`, `json-schema.manifest` and `export-origins` do not move (no export renamed); `authorable-surface.base.json` is written only by `gen:authorable-surface-base` and is untouched. `acceptRetiredDefaultResidue` is not needed: no built artifact or stored row carries a registry entry.
- **Size.** 162 files, +1509 / −649 = 2158 changed lines, generated included, under the 3,000 line. The pin round's own files: 21, +350 / −79.

## Not in this PR

- The governed text (S3): `AGENTS.md` Prime Directive 7, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, ADR-0005 (and the dated ADR records).
- cloud's two test helpers (`service-ai-studio` `write-door.ts` and `metadata-tools.test.ts`): recorded on the card (`6109343061` item 5) for a seat that reaches cloud.
- CHANGELOGs and every other pending changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:platform-checklist` is red on this head on 8 findings in files this PR does not touch, each byte-identical to `main`: the 7 recorded in round 1 (`areas/access-security.json`, `areas/attachments-storage.json`) and one more, `areas/search.json` citing `protocol.ts#countable`, a symbol main's PR #22857 (`55382dc02a`) removed. `countable` reads 0 in `protocol.ts` on `origin/main` and on this head. Not this diff.
- The ADR-0087 marker names only the D3 id: the gate resolves ids from the semantic and conversion registries and refused the retired-keys string as an id. The retired-keys entry is named in the changeset body.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:migration-registry` does not exist (the registry is git-ignored and generated); `gen:migration-registry` ran green on this head (424 semantic, 259 retired-key, 222 retired-def).
- This branch merged `main` at `018b077fbf` (round 2, through `os-regen-merge.sh`; two hand-written conflicts, `email-template.zod.ts` and `liveness/README.md`, resolved by stacking both intents). `main` has moved 9 commits since; `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` is clean, and none of those commits adds a line naming either key or an asserting pin citation.

## Verification (head `49ef13a518`)

- `@objectstack/spec`: `typecheck` exit 0; `test` (local) 649 files / 19398 tests passed (1 todo); `repo` project: the absence pin, `retired-key-migrate-sentence` and `step18-rationale-merge`, 3 files / 26 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: `test` 226 files passed, 3 skipped (28171 tests passed, 19 skipped); `typecheck` exit 0.
- `@objectstack/objectql`: S1's `environment-overlay-five-types.test.ts` and the wire pin `protocol-meta-types-rich.test.ts`, 2 files / 33 tests passed.
- Built first: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/example-showcase...` (61 tasks, exit 0); later, eight packages outside that closure, by name, for two gates' prerequisites and the boot (`client-react`, the five packages `check:published-readme-exports` reads, `studio`, `service-cluster-redis`). No `pnpm build`. `check:generated` exit 0 (all 14 artifacts up to date against that dist); `check:api-surface` "unchanged"; `check:authorable-surface` exit 0 (`authorable-surface.base.json` trails `018b077fbf88`, an information line); `check:future-spec-major` exit 0 (no citation names a major above 17, with the version word gone from the prescription).
- The Console Pin Gate's steps: see the pin section; every step exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) at this head printed 155 commands; every one run except two, and `--ran` reconciles: 155 derived, 153 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (claimed), 0 UNRUN. Exit codes: 152 × 0 and `check:platform-checklist` × 1 (above). `check:skill-examples` first refused with exit 3 (`@objectstack/client-react` unbuilt), then exit 0 after that package was built. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no whole-workspace build this round) and `check:type-check-debt` (the derived command is the `--re-measure` this round does not run).
- Artifact rosters (41), with `PR_NUMBER=22874`, `PR_HEAD_REF`, `PR_BODY` and `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` wired for `closing-target-claim`, `partof-closing-keyword` and `single-claim-paths`: 41 × exit 0. Two needed a rerun: `check:published-readme-exports` refused with exit 3 until five packages outside the showcase closure were built, and `check:select-shard-packages`'s self-test compared output that the proxy variable the PR-context guards need had polluted with a warning; rerun without it, exit 0.
- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier): 1828 cases pass, exit 0. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` exit 0: two declared-breaking changesets, `22340-registry-allow-environment-overlay.md` (`registered metadata-type-registry-allow-org-override-renamed`) and `console-e5311165a8d6.md` (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).
